Here is the test suite in xUnit Test Cases notation:

```python
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
from your_module import your_function

class TestVirtua3_4(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_tc_001(self):
        # [VIRTUA-3.4-1] The system will be available on hospital Padmavathi website as a URL
        url = "https://hospital-padmavathi.com/virtua"
        response = requests.get(url)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)

    def test_tc_002(self):
        # [VIRTUA-3.4-2] Patients, Chemists and Labs will connect through a secured encrypted connection over internet
        with patch('your_module.your_function', return_value=True):
            self.assertTrue(your_function())

    def test_tc_003(self):
        # [VIRTUA-3.4-3] Encrypted protocols are used to prevent data leakages
        with patch('your_module.your_function', return_value=True):
            self.assertTrue(your_function())

    def test_tc_004(self):
        # [VIRTUA-3.4-4] E-mails shall be used to send the Prescription and Invoice to the Patients after Consultation
        with patch('your_module.your_function', return_value=True):
            self.assertTrue(your_function())

    def test_tc_005(self):
        # Negative path: Test that the system is not available when the URL is incorrect
        url = "https://hospital-padmavathi.com/virtua/incorrect"
        response = requests.get(url)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 404)

    def test_tc_006(self):
        # Boundary value: Test that the system is available when the URL is correct but the protocol is incorrect
        url = "http://hospital-padmavathi.com/virtua"
        response = requests.get(url)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)

    def test_tc_007(self):
        # Boundary value: Test that the system is available when the URL is correct but the port is incorrect
        url = "https://hospital-padmavathi.com:8080/virtua"
        response = requests.get(url)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)

    def test_tc_008(self):
        # Error path: Test that the system raises an exception when the URL is incorrect
        with self.assertRaises(requests.exceptions.RequestException):
            requests.get("https://hospital-padmavathi.com/virtua/incorrect")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```
